name: Scoreboard
description: A score bug for two teams or players: names, team colours, scores, the period and an optional clock text; a changed score animates with a soft glow.

params.name: home_name
params.help: First (left) team or player, short, e.g. LIONS or Team A

params.name: home_colour
params.help: Left team colour #rrggbb (empty: the accent colour)

params.name: period
params.help: Period text, e.g. Q3, 2nd half, Round 4 (empty: none)

params.name: clock
params.help: Clock text as shown, e.g. 67:12 (it does not run by itself; update it or leave empty)
